newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mycogen estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mycogen estimates cut.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Inc Thursday reduced its earnings estimate for Mycogen Corp in fiscal 1997 to a loss of $0.22 a share from a profit of $0.05 and lowered the estimate for 1998 to a profit of $0.25 a share from net income of $0.50.

-- Dain cited a conference call with the comapny related to Mycogen's patent litigation costs, which could amount to $0.20 a share for fiscal 1997. Mycogen may also experience a slight market share loss in the wake of its merger with United AgriSeeds in fiscal 1996, Dain said.
-- Mycogen's second-quarter earnings were $0.08 a share, versus analysts' expectations of $0.22, Dain said.
-- Mycogen is an aricultural biotechnology company.
-- Its shares were unchanged Thursday at 18-3/4.
